data.title: The *self-check* loop
data.subtitle: (six steps for work with your name on it)

start.heading: Start
lines: One task that matters: a report, an email, a plan, a model.

stops.heading: Set the finish line
lines: Write 3 to 7 tests the work must pass.

stops.heading: Allow "I don't know"
lines: Ask it to flag gaps instead of filling them.

stops.heading: Trace every claim
lines: Every number, name and quote gets a source.

stops.heading: Grade against the list
lines: Pass, partly or fail, with evidence.

stops.heading: Attack the weak spots
lines: The three strongest reasons it's wrong.

stops.heading: Fix, log, hand over
lines: Fix only what failed. Show what changed.

finish.heading: Your turn
lines: Check the flagged items and the sources yourself. Then it ships.
